flags.reason: The guide’s Configuration captions for Emphasis (“A solid circle.”, “A pale circle with a coloured icon.”, “No circle, just the coloured icon.”) are drawn on AppearanceBrand Secondary but read as true for every appearance. On the installed 0.1.78-dbe0e02, read through the package’s resolver, Emphasis Medium on Neutral is a lighter grey #545961 with a white glyph and on Tertiary the circle stays #036b99 with only the glyph pale (#b3d3e0). The entry keeps the captions with “the guide shows it on AppearanceBrand Secondary”. Guide fix #527. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch8, for Marcin to confirm.

props.name: iconName
props.description: Any name in the Coin icon set (about 1,300). An unknown name draws the circle with no glyph and logs a warning. Declared: The name of the icon to display from the icon registry. Default "ic_card", from the component source.

props.name: source
props.description: A fallback glyph (SVG, raster or element), used only when iconName isn't in the icon set. Because iconName defaults to ic_card, source alone never shows: with no iconName the capsule draws ic_card; with an empty or unknown iconName it draws the source. Declared: Unified fallback source rendered when `iconName` is missing or not in the registry. Accepts a remote URI, an inline SVG XML string, a `require()` asset, an SVG React component, or an already-rendered element. The resulting media is tinted with the capsule's mode-resolved icon color so it follows design tokens just like a built-in icon. See {@link UnifiedSource}.

props.name: modes
props.description: Merged over a JFSThemeProvider's modes; the capsule's own modes win. Declared: Mode configuration for design tokens (e.g., {"AppearanceBrand": "Primary"})

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accepted and discarded: the capsule is an image with no name, and its glyph is hidden from screen readers. Declared: Accessibility label for screen readers.

props.name: accessibilityRole
props.description: Accessibility role (defaults to "image" for decorative icons) Performance notes: - All token reads collapsed into a single `useMemo([modes])`. The merged `(globalModes + propModes)` object is also memoized so downstream `getVariableByName` calls hit the resolver's per-modes-object cache. - Wrapped in `React.memo`; with the shared `EMPTY_MODES` default the common path benefits from full memoization. /. Default "image", from the component source.

props.name: ...React.ComponentProps<typeof View>
props.description: Inherited React Native props the component also accepts. They are not part of the design contract and no guide documents them.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: At Emphasis High: Primary #cea15a with a black glyph (the default), Secondary #5d00b5, Neutral #303338 and Tertiary #036b99, each with a white glyph. Declared: A token collection IconCapsule reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: With Semantic Intent System: positive #26ab21, warning #f06e0f, negative #f50030, each with a white glyph. Declared: A token collection IconCapsule reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection IconCapsule reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Context
modes.description: Default and ListItem use Icon Capsule Size; Nudge&Alert fixes the capsule at 14 px with a 14 px glyph, CTACard at 58 px with a 29 px glyph. Parent components set it. Declared: A token collection IconCapsule reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

Declared: A token collection IconCapsule reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Icon Capsule Size
modes.description: Circle and glyph: XS 18 / 12 px, S 29 / 18, M 42 / 18 (the default), L 81 / 36. Declared: A token collection IconCapsule reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.description: JioPlus changes only Neutral Low: its glyph turns white. Declared: A token collection IconCapsule reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Semantic Intent
modes.description: System colours the capsule with AppearanceSystem; Emphasis and AppearanceBrand then change nothing, so System with Emphasis Low is still filled. Declared: A token collection IconCapsule reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: Figma's Icon Capsule has a Type property, Default or Glass; the package has no type prop and never reads the iconCapsule/glass/background token, so there is no Glass capsule in code (Component Bug #419).
Figma's default Icon Capsule is Neutral High (dark grey, white glyph); the package with no modes, and Storybook's Default, are Primary High (gold, black glyph) (Component Bug #419).

The JSDoc and Biscuit's IconCapsule.mdx say source is used when iconName is missing, but iconName defaults to ic_card, so source never shows on its own: only with an empty or unknown iconName (Component Bug #419).
